task_title: Slice 4b: tangential-to-gradient seam term on NAVMESH_FUSED fan

plan_review.notes: Adversarial red-team (gpt-5.5, high) of the fork-A tangential-to-gradient seam term on the shared RISK_REWARD_FUSED fan. Enumerated 6 alternatives (A guarded-duplicate vs helper-extract; B centered/contrast gradient; C finite-difference field; D nearest-threat tangent; E route-level poly cost [rejected: violates pure-query]; F reward-being-on-seam [creator-rejected, confirmed weaker]). Verdict: sound-with-changes, ~4 apples, split term/tune. 11 concerns adopted: B1 keep weight-0 path LITERALLY unchanged (no computeCandidateDanger extraction) -> adopted: seam logic entirely behind if(seamWeight>0), main loop stores {dir,danger,score} only under that guard + skipped post-loop block -> byte-identical by construction. B2 raw sum has forward-semicircle bias -> adopted CENTERED estimator grad=sum(dir_i*(danger_i-meanDanger)); zero contrast => seam inactive. B3 finite/epsSq/tie handling for gradient+tangent sign -> adopted (gradLenSq>EPS gate, no-flip on exact 0). M1 reward gate flicker -> epsilon gate + report seam-active toggle rate in sweep. M2 seam can overpower progress -> progress-floor gate (no seam bonus below SEAM_PROGRESS_FLOOR) + report completion time/timeouts. M3 prevFusedDir stale-tangent -> tangent recomputed fresh each poll (never carried); track seam-active-prev + report flicker, add hysteresis only if sweep shows oscillation. M4 fallback metric blind to off-route seam drag -> report completion time + timeout count (+ off-corridor distance if cheap). M5 danger-band occupancy insufficient -> richer metric: seam-active frame fraction + mean chosenDir.tangent while active (directional travel proof) + danger-band occupancy (mode-agnostic before/after). m1 clamp seamWeight finite>=0 (config field, no env read). m2 debug schema exposes gradient/tangent/seamAlign/effectiveSeamWeight/seam-active reason for lab overlay. m3 no allocation on weight-0 path. Divergence=minor: design intact, gradient estimator tightened + guards added.

NOT a rule-#12 weakening. Post-fix: unit 11/11 green, typecheck exit 0, headless golden PASSED at w=2 (2/2 byte-identical).
